    "category"
];

"""Return the set of golden features common to every training/testing header."""
def common_get(list_header: list[list[str]]) -> set[str] {
    golden_list = [
        [fea for fea in header if fea.startswith(tuple(GOLDEN_FEA))]
        for header in list_header
    ];
    common = set(golden_list[0]);
    for feats in golden_list[1:] {
        common.intersection_update(feats);
    }
    return common;
}
